notes: The callee (words 8-14) sits after the caller's buffer_store/s_endpgm (words 5-7), and its s_setpc_b64 (word 15) returns to the store at word 5, so the call itself cannot be inlined faithfully. This adapter replays only the callee's ALU words [8,15) without the s_call/s_setpc: the results are the same values the test asserts, but the call-after-endpgm control flow (the test's subject) is not exercised.
Results 0..3 are v4..v7 (add 0x13579bdf, xor 0xa5a5a5a5, v6+v7, xor 0x5a5a5a5a); post copies them to v10..v13. All four asserted for every lane.
Rows: Run() sets Input[tid*4..+3] = {Selectors[tid % 8], 0x9e3779b9*(tid+1), 0xffffffff - tid, 17*tid + 1}; Selectors = {0,1,2,3,4,7,0x80000000,0xffffffff}.
The test dispatches one wave of 32 lanes and one of 64 lanes (and a 64-lane dispatch on a wave32 target when distinct). The .wave64 file covers the 64-lane run.
